idea-plugin.name: Workspace Defaults
idea-plugin.description:
One set of settings for all Gradle builds of a workspace, like Eclipse workspace preferences.

A workspace is the project opened in IntelliJ IDEA; with the Multi-Project Workspace plugin it is the workspace project with all its subprojects. The defaults are stored in its .idea folder. Clicking Apply overwrites the managed settings of every build; newly linked builds get them automatically.

  • Gradle distribution (wrapper, local installation, bundled) and Gradle JVM for all linked builds
  • Build and run using / Run tests using (Gradle or IntelliJ IDEA)
  • Project SDK and language level, project and properties encoding, line separator
  • Exclude folders by name from indexing, e.g. Eclipse bin folders with compiled classes
  • Compiler settings of the IntelliJ IDEA build: @NotNull assertions, deprecation warnings, annotation processing
  • Map Git and SVN working copies that have no VCS mapping yet (SVN needs the Subversion plugin)
  • List of all builds and settings that differ from the defaults
